items.text: No Zay Flowers again at Thursday practice (second straight DNP) with hamstring. Ja'Kobi Lane already on IR with fractured wrist.
items.why: Hamstring aggravated Week 1; two DNPs lean toward sitting vs Saints.
items.implication: Likely OUT or GTD; Lamar Jackson target tree thins.
items.opportunity: If OUT, Bateman becomes WR1; Walker/Wester/Sarratt/Moore next.

items.text: If Zay Flowers (hamstring) can't go, Ravens WRs: 1. Rashod Bateman 2. Devontez Walker 3. LaJohntay Wester 4. Elijah Sarratt 5. Chris Moore. Lane already IR/return.
items.why: Clear hierarchy based on current depth with Flowers/Lane out.
items.implication: Bateman flex-worthy if Flowers sits; Andrews elevated.
items.opportunity: Target share vacuum in Ravens pass game.

items.text: LOVE Kenneth Walker vs IND: 24% target share (tied team lead, 2nd-highest career) in Chiefs debut; 21/24 RB touches through 3Q, 40% routes targeted. Indy gave up 163 yds/3 TDs to Henry. RB1 overall in range of outcomes.
items.why: Workhorse usage + elite matchup; preseason RB1 range call holds.
items.opportunity: 74% snaps, high target share as true workhorse.

items.text: Nico Collins hammy at Wednesday practice (history missed 5 in 2024). Routes last week on 42 Stroud dropbacks: Collins 37, Hutchinson 29, Boutte 27, Noel 15, Wayne 8. MRI pending.
items.why: Dominant route share + soft-tissue history flags high miss risk.
items.implication: Bench Collins; target Hutchinson/Boutte/Schultz as pivots.
items.opportunity: 37/42 routes show alpha role if healthy.

items.text: Patriots RB TreVeyon Henderson (ankle) full participant in practice; 'I'm ready to go.' Indication he could return Sunday.
items.why: Full practice after ankle issue; self-reported ready.
items.implication: Likely plays; monitor for role vs Rhamondre.
items.opportunity: Potential dual-threat usage if full go.

items.text: Bengals QB Joe Burrow dealing with back tightness, DNP Wednesday but got mental reps and expects to play Sunday.
items.why: Back tightness limited practice but self-expects to play.
items.implication: Monitor Friday; likely plays but risk if worsens.

items.text: Week 2 waiver injury beneficiaries: Ladd McConkey=Tre Harris; Ja'Kobi Lane=Rashod Bateman/Chris Moore; De'Zhaun Stribling=Deebo Samuel; Alvin Kamara=Kendre Miller; A.J. Brown=Romeo Doubs/DeMario Douglas.
items.implication: Priority adds for immediate/ high-upside production.

items.text: LOVE Bucky Irving vs CLE: Career-high 26% target share Week 1, 8 more routes than Gainwell, both RB RZ touches. CLE allowed 121 rush/4.8 YPC.
items.opportunity: 26% tgt, all RZ RB touches, route edge.

items.text: LOVE Justin Jefferson @ CHI: 37% target share from Wentz Week 1; 93 yds/18 PPG avg in 6 career games with Wentz. CHI allowed 10+ YPT to CAR WRs.
items.why: Elite share + proven Wentz chemistry + soft secondary.

items.text: HATE Travis Etienne @ BAL: Matched Miller rush attempts Week 1; 69% fantasy pts via air. Kamara expected back squeezes role; 8.5-pt underdogs vs BAL bad script.
HATE Marvin Harrison Jr. vs SEA: 8% target share Week 1 (5th on team), zero RZ looks. SEA 3rd-fewest PPG to WRs since last year.
items.why: Anemic share + tough secondary + Bourne competition.

items.text: LOVE Ashton Jeanty @ LAC: Utilization Score 99 in Week 1 (tied Bijan for lead). 19% target share last 10 games; 25+ touches in 3 of last 4.
items.why: Elite util + consistent volume post-injury scare overreaction.

items.text: Sneaky optimistic debut for Kenyon Sadiq (16th overall): 28 snaps despite missing OTAs/camp mostly. Schemed goal-line carry + screen + 2 other targets. Clear intent to get him ball.
items.implication: Stash TE/RB hybrid; high touch intent.
items.opportunity: Goal-line carry + designed targets on 28 snaps.
